name: Chiang Mai
tagline: The Original Digital Nomad Capital — Retire for Less in Thailand's Rose of the North
description: Chiang Mai is the undisputed champion of affordable FIRE living in Southeast Asia. With a thriving expat community, world-class temples, lush mountain scenery, and a cost of living that lets you stretch every dollar, it remains the gold standard for early retirees seeking quality of life on a modest portfolio.

quickFacts.visa: 60-day tourist visa on arrival; Long-Term Resident (LTR) visa available for retirees with $80K+ income or $1M+ assets; Thailand Privilege visa ($15K–$30K) for 5–20 year stays
quickFacts.safetyRating: Very Safe — low violent crime, occasional petty theft in tourist areas
quickFacts.nearestAirport: Chiang Mai International Airport (CNX) — direct flights to Bangkok, Singapore, Kuala Lumpur
quickFacts.climate: Tropical savanna with three seasons: hot (Mar–May), rainy (Jun–Oct), cool (Nov–Feb)

housing.description: Modern studio / 1BR in Nimman, Santitham, or near the Old City, pool

dining.description: Local Thai and street food, the occasional Western café

healthcare.description: Individual local Thai plan, early-retiree band, Ram Hospital access

1M.lifestyle: A clean, modern studio or one-bedroom in Nimman, Santitham, or near the Old City, pool included. Mostly local Thai and street food with the odd Western café, getting around by scooter and songthaew, and a local Thai health plan covering Ram or Bangkok Hospital Chiang Mai. The mountains, temples, and markets are effectively free. Comfortable and genuinely cheap — the trade-offs are limited nightlife and a smaller range of imported goods.

housing.description: Spacious 2-bedroom condo or small townhouse in a desirable neighborhood with modern amenities

dining.description: Mix of Thai street food, upscale local restaurants, and regular Western dining

healthcare.description: Comprehensive private health insurance with dental; access to top-tier hospitals

transportation.description: Own scooter plus occasional Grab car rides and weekend road trips

entertainment.description: Gym membership, regular Thai cooking classes, weekend trips to Pai or Chiang Rai, streaming services

2M.lifestyle: A nicer one-bedroom or small condo with room for a home office, dining out several times a week across local and Western spots. A scooter plus Grab for convenience, a broader private health plan with dental, and easy weekend runs to Pai or Chiang Rai. Life here is relaxed and uncomplicated, with a comfortable cushion each month. (Interpolated tier.)

housing.description: Premium high-rise unit with city views or a smart condo in the Nimman/Riverside belt

dining.description: The best restaurants in town regularly — sushi, Italian, Thai tasting menus

healthcare.description: Comprehensive local plan or entry international, evacuation to Bangkok

transportation.description: Leased car or SUV plus a scooter, occasional domestic flights

entertainment.description: Gym, golf, spa, cultural festivals, weekend trips north

3M.lifestyle: A premium high-rise unit with city views or a smart condo in the Nimman/Riverside belt, dining at the best restaurants in town regularly — good sushi, Italian, and Thai tasting menus. A leased car or SUV for drives through the north, plus a strong private or mid international plan. At this budget in Chiang Mai, very little is out of reach.

housing.description: Stunning private estate or luxury villa compound with pool, gardens, and mountain views

dining.description: Private chef for most meals plus frequent fine dining at Chiang Mai's top establishments

healthcare.description: Top-tier international insurance with Bumrungrad Bangkok access and annual executive health checks

transportation.description: Owned or leased luxury vehicle, private driver available, regular domestic flights

entertainment.description: Country club memberships, private yoga instruction, art collecting, regular travel across Southeast Asia

domesticHelp.description: Full-time housekeeper/cook, part-time gardener, and regular laundry service

luxuryExtras.description: Monthly spa packages, bespoke tailoring, premium wine subscriptions, charitable donations to local temples

5M.lifestyle: A large villa with pool and mountain views, a housekeeper and cook covering most of the home and meals, and a nice car with a driver on call. International health cover with Bumrungrad access and annual executive checks, plus regular flights and travel across the region. This budget stretches a very long way here — daily life is genuinely affluent with room to spare. (Interpolated tier.)

housing.description: Large villa/premium compound with pool and Doi Suthep views

dining.description: Frequent fine dining (a limited scene) plus a private chef a few days a week

transportation.description: Luxury vehicle plus a driver, regular domestic flights

entertainment.description: Country club, wellness, travel across Southeast Asia

domesticHelp.description: Housekeeper/cook plus a part-time gardener for the residence

luxuryExtras.description: Luxury travel, bespoke, wine, wellness programs

10M.lifestyle: A large, well-appointed property with pool and Doi Suthep views, a housekeeper, a cook a few days a week, and a gardener and driver. Concierge-level international health cover, fine dining whenever wanted, and first-class regional travel. This is far more budget than Chiang Mai can absorb — life is very comfortable with no real constraints, though the city stays a small, quiet place with a modest high-end ceiling.
